description: courtscheduler.move-hearing-to-past-date — books a hearing onto past session(s), both jurisdictions. Past dates only: startTime/endTime on or after today (UTC) is a 422 FUTURE_DATE_NOT_ALLOWED. MAGISTRATES (main's behaviour, SPRDT-1447): per sitting day, the session in courtRoomId whose window contains the startTime time-of-day (any court_session, weekends included); the submitted window is the booked duration (a full court day per day for a multi-day span) and the submitted start/end are returned on each session. CROWN: a single-day move without courtScheduleId books the session in courtRoomId on that date whose window contains the startTime time-of-day (no room fallback); anchored or multi-day moves book consecutive weekday sessions in one room + business type. Any move with no matching past session is a 422 NO_SESSION_FOUND.
